prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but “best” depends on your needs (budget, whole house vs one room, historic home, timeline). Do you want me to recommend specific companies in your neighborhood, or would you prefer a short checklist and questions to use when comparing painters?

If you want a quick way to find the best fit, tell me:
- Your ZIP code or neighborhood in St. Louis (city, county, suburb)
- Scope (one room, apartment, whole house, commercial)
- Budget range or quality level (basic, mid-range, high-end/custom)
- Any concerns (lead paint, historic trim, color consultation)

If you want to start now, here’s a compact guide you can use to identify the best interior painting company:

What to look for
- Strong local reviews on Google/Yelp/Angi and recent job photos/portfolio.
- Current liability insurance and workers’ comp.
- Written estimate with itemized costs (labor, paint, prep, repairs).
- Clear scope: surface prep, priming, number of coats, trim/cabinet work, cleanup.
- Paint brands and sheen specified (Benjamin Moore, Sherwin‑Williams, etc.).
- Warranty/guarantee and touch‑up policy.
- References from recent local jobs (ask to see similar projects).
- Lead-safe certified (EPA) if your house was built before 1978.

Five questions to ask every contractor
1. Are you licensed and insured? Can I see proof?
2. Will you provide an itemized written estimate and contract?
3. What surface prep will you do (repairs, sanding, priming)?
4. Which paint brands and sheens will you use, and how many coats?
5. Can I see references or photos of completed jobs like mine?

Red flags
- No written estimate or contract.
- Extremely low bids with large upfront payment.
- Poor or no online reviews; refusal to provide references.
- Vague answers about prep, warranty, or cleanup.

If you want, I can:
- Draft a short message or checklist to send to painters.
- Help compare 3–4 estimates if you paste them here.
- Search for top-rated painters in your ZIP code (tell me the ZIP and I’ll produce a recommended shortlist based on recent review criteria — I’ll need your permission to run a web search).

Which would you prefer?
